summary: Paced export and Reader sync preserve incremental filters and watermarks, apply all tombstones, and aggregate one summary.
reason: Runner is hand-written (no generated header) but the dispatch in generated sync.go can be reverted by regen-merge, silently restoring the unpaced generic sync. Markers pin the dispatch and the pacing/cursor core.
markers: return runReadwiseExportSyncCmd(cmd, flags, resources, full, since, concurrency, dbPath, maxPages, latestOnly, strict, paramFlags, resourceParamFlags, globalParamFlags)
reapply: Restore the generated sync dispatch into the paced Readwise runner. Every export page, including full and resumed pages, must request includeDeleted=true. Preserve run filters alongside cursors and last completed watermarks until completion; completed runs use the start time. Batch book/highlight tombstones atomically and preserve error causes and one summary for the entire run.
